rows.name: You[XENO:line ] What are you trying to do?!
There's no place for you in the new age.
Talco-nee-chan[XENO:line ]
Don't worry. I'll protect you and your research.
Look at how wide the rift in the sky has grown.
It is proof that god has rejected you.
That's a rather convenient interpretation.
Oh! Melia-sama! Our hope!
You! What are you doing?!
As you can see, I'm removing some pebbles.
Their research is a desecration of mixed blood.
Do you understand what this research means?

The future of the High Entia
depends on this research!
This research is our future?

You call reviving a race that perished on its own
our future[XENO:line ]?
We are the future of the High Entia!

All High Entia ought to be of mixed blood!
That is our true form!
Without our ancestors, none of us would exist!
Ancestors?
There are no such people.
Melia-sama herself is the ancestor of the High Entia.
The first of our people and our future!
What nonsense.[XENO:line ]

If you insist on hindering this research
for such foolish beliefs,
I will show no mercy, even to my own kin!
Melia[XENO:line ]
Why do you not understand?!
Why can't you see that we're the rightful ones?!

There is no orthodoxy or heresy
in the history we've lived!
Enough!

I'll remove you, become our forebear myself,
and lead our people!
